focus_areas: Feather texture realism (individual strand definition vs. smearing)
Anatomical correctness of the neck-to-body transition
Iridescence rendering on black tail feathers
Definitive confirmation of leg/foot occlusion via object detection
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the junction where the red neck feathers meet the black body feathers. In AI images, this area often suffers from 'color bleeding' or lack of distinct feather layering. Also, scrutinize the red hackles for a 'painted' or plastic-like smoothness that lacks the chaotic detail of real keratin structures. Finally, rely on the open_vocabulary_detector results to confirm if the legs/feet are truly occluded or if they are missing/hallucinated.
image_description: A side-profile view of a rooster (cock) standing on a wooden surface. The bird features vibrant red hackle feathers on the neck, a black body and tail with iridescent sheen, and a prominent red comb and wattle. The background consists of blurred green foliage and a wire fence.
